001: Ivan, were you at yesterday's conference? They say there were a lot of useful connections there.
Yes, Elena, I met representatives from three large companies. Very useful contacts.
That's great! And how did you manage to start talking to them? I always feel shy about approaching people first.
I just went up after their presentation and asked a question. People like it when you're interested in their work.
Maybe I should try that approach at the next exhibition.
You definitely should. The main thing is to be sincere and not be afraid to start a conversation.
002: Dmitry, I got an invitation to a business dinner on Friday. Would you like to join?
I'd love to, Maria. And who will be at this dinner, if it's not a secret?
Our partners from Saint Petersburg will be there, and possibly their new investors.
That's a great opportunity to discuss future cooperation in an informal setting.
I agree. I've already prepared a few questions about their new projects.
Then I'll prepare too. Together we can make a good impression.
003: Alexey, do you happen to know the head of the purchasing department at the company "Vector"?
Unfortunately, no, Olga. Why do you ask?
We need to discuss delivery terms with them, but we can't get in touch with them directly.
I can ask my colleague, he worked with them last year.
That would be wonderful. The more intermediaries there are, the harder it is to negotiate.
I understand. I'll write to him today and try to arrange a meeting.
004: Sergey, I heard you're going to the industry forum at the end of the month.
Yes, Anna, I'm planning to. Are you going there too?
Yes, but I'm going alone, and I feel a bit uncomfortable. Would you like to go together?
Great idea. We can split the travel expenses and attend the key sessions together.
And we can also introduce each other to our contacts. I have a couple of useful acquaintances there.
Same here. I also know a few people you should meet.
005: Ivan, could you introduce me to the management of the company "Stroyinvest" next week?
Of course, Elena. I know their commercial director well.
Really? That would be very valuable for our new project.
I'm sure he'll be interested in discussing cooperation opportunities with you.
Then I'll prepare a brief presentation of our latest developments.
Great. I'll arrange a meeting for Wednesday, if that works for you.
006: Maria, did you exchange business cards with the representatives of the delegation from Kazan?
Yes, Dmitry, of course. I always collect all the contacts after such events.
And what do you usually do with those contacts afterwards? Just keep them in a drawer?
No, the next day I send each person a short email thanking them for the introduction.
That's a very professional approach. I usually lose all my business cards.
Try this method. It really helps maintain the connection and build trust.
007: Olga, I got an invitation to the anniversary of our long-time partner. Will you be there too?
Yes, Alexey, I was invited as well. I think there will be a lot of important people there.
Then let's agree to introduce each other to our acquaintances. That will make it easier.
Agreed. I know several executives who would be interested in meeting you.
And I'll introduce you to our potential clients from the neighboring region.
Perfect. Such events are the best way to expand your circle of business contacts.
008: Anna, do you know who's organizing the summer conference on innovations?
I do, Sergey. It's an old acquaintance of mine, she heads the organizing committee.
Could you introduce us? We want to offer our venue for hosting it.
Of course, I can. I'm sure she'll be interested in discussing this proposal.
That would be ideal. Direct contact with the organizers solves many issues.
Yes, personal recommendations always work better than cold emails. I'll get in touch with her tomorrow.
009: Dmitry, I found out that our competitor has started negotiations with our key supplier.
That's serious news, Elena. We need to urgently strengthen our relationship with them.
I suggest inviting their management to a meeting and discussing long-term cooperation.
Great idea. I have a good relationship with their financial director.
Then you could arrange an informal meeting, and I'll prepare a commercial proposal.
Deal. We need to act quickly and show that we are reliable partners.
010: Alexey, are you still in touch with those specialists we met in Moscow?
Yes, Olga, we message each other on a professional network and sometimes have calls.
That's good. Such connections can be useful for future joint projects.
Absolutely agree. One of them has already offered us to participate in their company's tender.
Seriously? That's great news! We definitely need to consider this offer.
I've already requested the details. I hope this becomes the start of a long cooperation.
